name: features-section-demo-3
blurb: Bento grid of mixed-size feature cards with embedded skeleton content.
description: Four feature cards in a bento layout (varied column spans) with titles, descriptions, and placeholder skeleton components. Responsive 1-column mobile to 6-column desktop.
use_when: Feature sections where visual variety and mixed card sizes create an editorial, high-impact layout.
avoid_when: Content-dense, linear flows where bento asymmetry might distract or complicate reading order.
a11y: Heading and description text is semantic. Skeleton placeholders are decorative. Card order is logical in responsive stacking.
